entries.title: Psalms 68:1
segments: ¶<To the chief music-maker. Of David. A Psalm. A Song.> Let God be seen, and let his haters be put to flight; let those who are against him be turned back before him.

entries.title: Psalms 68:2
segments: Let them be like smoke before the driving wind; as wax turning soft before the fire, so let them come to an end before the power of God.

entries.title: Psalms 68:3
segments: But let the upright be glad; let them have delight before God; let them be full of joy.

entries.title: Psalms 68:4
segments: Make songs to God, make songs of praise to his name; make a way for him who comes through the waste lands; his name is Jah; be glad before him.

entries.title: Psalms 68:5
segments: A father to those who have no father, a judge of the widows, is God in his holy place.

entries.title: Psalms 68:6
segments: Those who are without friends, God puts in families; he makes free those who are in chains; but those who are turned away from him are given a dry land.

entries.title: Psalms 68:7
segments: ¶O God, when you went out before your people, wandering through the waste land; (Selah.)

entries.title: Psalms 68:8
segments: The earth was shaking and the heavens were streaming, because God was present; even Sinai itself was moved before God, the God of Israel.

entries.title: Psalms 68:9
segments: You, O God, did freely send the rain, giving strength to the weariness of your heritage.

entries.title: Psalms 68:10
segments: Those whose resting-place was there, even the poor, were comforted by your good things, O God.

entries.title: Psalms 68:11
segments: The Lord gives the word; great is the number of the women who make it public.

entries.title: Psalms 68:12
segments: Kings of armies quickly go in flight: and the women in the houses make a division of their goods.

entries.title: Psalms 68:13
segments: Will you take your rest among the flocks? like the wings of a dove covered with silver, and its feathers with yellow gold.

entries.title: Psalms 68:14
segments: When the Most High put the kings to flight, it was as white as snow in Salmon.

entries.title: Psalms 68:15
segments: ¶A hill of God is the hill of Bashan; a hill with high tops is the hill of Bashan.

entries.title: Psalms 68:16
segments: Why are you looking with envy, you high hills, on the hill desired by God as his resting-place? truly, God will make it his house for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 68:17
segments: The war-carriage of God is among Israel's thousands; the Lord has come from Sinai to the holy place.

entries.title: Psalms 68:18
segments: You have gone up on high, taking your prisoners with you; you have taken offerings from men; the Lord God has taken his place on the seat of his power.

entries.title: Psalms 68:19
segments: Praise be to the Lord, who is our support day by day, even the God of our salvation. (Selah.)

entries.title: Psalms 68:20
segments: Our God is for us a God of salvation; his are the ways out of death.

entries.title: Psalms 68:21
segments: The heads of the haters of God will be crushed; even the head of him who still goes on in his evil ways.

entries.title: Psalms 68:22
segments: ¶The Lord said, I will make them come back from Bashan, and from the deep parts of the sea;

entries.title: Psalms 68:23
segments: So that your foot may be red with blood, and the tongues of your dogs with the same.

entries.title: Psalms 68:24
segments: We see your going, O God: even the going of my God, my King, into the holy place.

entries.title: Psalms 68:25
segments: The makers of songs go before, the players of music come after, among the young girls playing on brass instruments.

entries.title: Psalms 68:26
segments: Give praise to God in the great meeting; even the Lord, you who come from the fountain of Israel.

entries.title: Psalms 68:27
segments: There is little Benjamin ruling them, the chiefs of Judah and their army, the rulers of Zebulun and the rulers of Naphtali.

entries.title: Psalms 68:28
segments: O God, send out your strength; the strength, O God, with which you have done great things for us,

entries.title: Psalms 68:29
segments: Out of your Temple in Jerusalem.

entries.title: Psalms 68:30
segments: Say sharp words to the beast among the water-plants, the band of strong ones, with the lords of the peoples, put an end to the people whose delight is in war.

entries.title: Psalms 68:31
segments: Kings will give you offerings, they will come out of Egypt; from Pathros will come offerings of silver; Ethiopia will be stretching out her hands to God.

entries.title: Psalms 68:32
segments: ¶Make songs to God, you kingdoms of the earth; O make songs of praise to the Lord; (Selah.)

entries.title: Psalms 68:33
segments: To him who goes or the clouds of heaven, the heaven which was from earliest times; he sends out his voice of power.

entries.title: Psalms 68:34
segments: Make clear that strength is God's: he is lifted up over Israel, and his power is in the clouds.

entries.title: Psalms 68:35
segments: O God, you are to be feared in your holy place: the God of Israel gives strength and power to his people. Praise be to God.
